_note: Degen Desk BTC autopilot. Edit ~/.degen-desk/autopilot/config.json then restart: autopilot.py start. Risk numbers are fractions (0.01 = 1%). account_index/api_key_index are read from your ~/.degen-desk/lt runner (lighter/install-local.sh) or the LIGHTER_ACCOUNT_INDEX / LIGHTER_API_KEY_INDEX environment variables; set them here only if you have neither.
